name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza strikes kill 4 on 21 Nov; Yemen active
summary: Gaza civil defence reports 10 killed by Israeli fire on 20–21 Nov; Israel struck Lebanon 19 Nov; Houthi missiles
state: Gaza's civil defence said Israeli fire killed four people on 21 Nov, three of them in a strike on a food-aid vehicle in Gaza City, after six deaths on 20 Nov; the Israeli military said it targeted militants (RTÉ; Gulf News). Israel struck a site in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley on 19 Nov that it said Hezbollah used for missile production (Shafaq News). On 21 Nov the Saudi-led coalition said it downed three Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh, and Iran attacked Bahrain the same night (Gulf News). Escalation on several fronts keeps the Alert.
for_you: Hostilities across Gaza, Lebanon, Yemen and the Gulf raise risks for travel and shipping in the region. Follow FCDO travel advice before travelling to Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon or Gulf states.
rubric_hit: Alert: multi-front escalation (Gaza strikes, Israel–Lebanon strikes, Houthi–Saudi exchanges, Iran–Bahrain attack)
